title: Signatory Rights Attestation
description: Attests which natural or legal persons hold signatory rights to engage a legal person, as registered in a national business register (EWC WP3). The claim structure follows the WE BUILD AuthorisedSignatories attestation.

vct.description: Verifiable credential type identifier of the Signatory Rights attestation.

legal_entity.description: Identifies the legal entity on whose behalf the authorised persons act. SHALL appear exactly once.

legal_person.description: The official legal name and legal form of the entity.

legal_person_name.description: The complete official legal name of the legal entity.

legal_form_type.description: The legal form of the legal entity (e.g., GmbH, S.A., Ltd, BV).

identifier.description: Legal identifiers for the entity. The EUID is mandatory; LEI and tax number are optional.

euid.description: The European Unique Identifier (EUID) of the legal entity per Directive (EU) 2017/1132. SHALL be a non-empty string.

lei.description: Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) per ISO 17442. When present, SHALL be exactly 20 characters.

tax.description: National company tax or registration number. Optional.

gln.description: Global Location Number for legal entities — GS1 identifier

duns.description: Data Universal Numbering System — Dun & Bradstreet identifier

eori.description: Economic Operators Registration and Identification number — EU customs identifier

bpnl.description: Business Partner Number Legal entity — Catena-X identifier per ICD 0243

siren.description: Système d'Identification du Répertoire des ENtreprises — French company identifier

authorised_persons.description: Array of authorised person objects. Each entry represents a natural person authorised to act on behalf of the legal entity.

items.description: A single authorised person entry containing personal, role, and optionally identification information.

natural_person.description: Core personal identity attributes of the authorised person. All three fields are mandatory.

first_name.description: The first names in full (including all given names and middle names) of the authorised person.

surname.description: The surnames in full (all family names/last names) of the authorised person.

date_of_birth.description: Day, month, and year of birth of the authorised person per ISO 8601. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

birth_place.description: Place of birth of the authorised person. Locality and country are mandatory; region is optional.

locality.description: Locality (city or town) where the natural person was born.

country.description: Country where the natural person was born. SHALL be a valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

region.description: Optional additional detail on the region or state of birth.

citizenship.description: Nationality or nationalities of the authorised person. SHALL contain at least one valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

items.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code representing a nationality held by the person.

person_role.description: Role and representation power of the authorised person within the legal entity. representation_type is mandatory; role is optional.

representation_type.description: The nature of the power of representation. SHALL be one of the standardized values defined in the rulebook: 'SOLE' (single signatory has full authority) or 'JOINT' (multiple signatories required).

role.description: The role of the authorised person within the company (e.g., CEO, CFO, Director). Optional.

email.description: The email of the authorised person. Optional.

phone.description: The phone of the authorised person. Optional.

residence_address.description: Optional residential address of the authorised person. When present, country SHALL be a valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.

address.description: The street address where the authorised person currently resides.

locality.description: The city where the authorised person currently resides.

postal_code.description: The postal or ZIP code of the authorised person's address.

region.description: The state, province, or region of the authorised person's address.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code where the authorised person resides.

identifier.description: Optional identity document details for enhanced identification of the authorised person. When present, ALL FOUR fields SHALL be provided together: document_type, document_number, issuing_country, and document_expiry_date.

document_type.description: Type of the identity document. SHALL use one of the standardized values defined in the rulebook.

document_number.description: The number of the identity document (passport number, national ID number, etc.).

issuing_country.description: The country that issued the identity document. SHALL be a valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

document_expiry_date.description: The expiration date of the identity document per ISO 8601. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

authorised_legal_persons.description: Array of legal persons that hold signatory rights over the legal entity. Optional; use it when a legal person, not a natural person, is the registered signatory.

items.description: A single legal person that is authorised to act on behalf of the legal entity.

legal_person.description: The official legal name of the signatory legal person as registered in the business register.

legal_person_name.description: The complete official legal name of the signatory legal person.

identifier.description: Legal identifier of the signatory legal person.

euid.description: The European Unique Identifier (EUID) of the signatory legal person per Directive (EU) 2017/1132. SHALL be a non-empty string.

person_role.description: Role and representation power of the signatory legal person within the legal entity. representation_type is mandatory; role is optional.

representation_type.description: The nature of the power of representation. SHALL be one of the standardized values defined in the rulebook: 'SOLE' (single signatory has full authority) or 'JOINT' (multiple signatories required).

role.description: The role of the authorised person within the company (e.g., CEO, CFO, Director). Optional.

iss.description: Issuer of the attestation, as an HTTPS URL that identifies the issuer.

iat.description: Time of issuance as a NumericDate (seconds since the Unix epoch).

nbf.description: Time before which the attestation is not valid, as a NumericDate.

exp.description: Time at which the attestation expires, as a NumericDate.

cnf.description: Confirmation claim that binds the attestation to the key of the holder (RFC 7800).

jwk.description: Public key of the holder as a JWK.

status.description: Reference to the Token Status List entry that carries the revocation status of the attestation.

idx.description: Index of the attestation in the status list.

uri.description: URI of the status list token.
